dedupe_keys.name: pypsa asean regional energy system model

description: PyPSA-ASEAN adapts PyPSA-Earth to represent the energy systems of the eleven ASEAN countries. The project publishes a sector-coupled optimisation workflow with regional transmission and capacity inputs and documentation for national or combined runs. Inputs include demand, generation and transmission assets, renewable resources, technology assumptions and scenario constraints. Outputs are optimised capacity, dispatch and flows for a user-selected spatial and temporal resolution. Its stated geographic coverage is Southeast Asia, with source data assembled from OpenStreetMap, national plans and other open datasets. Code is available under AGPL-3.0-or-later, with other terms attached to documentation and some data. A limitation is that the README labels regional validation as ongoing, so study results should not be presented as settled country forecasts. It supports cross-border electricity and heat-transition planning. The catalogue's model-pypsa-earth is the general parent workflow; this regional configuration and data are separate. No network dataset or solver run was downloaded.
inputs: ASEAN demand, generation and transmission inputs
